statement: `values` is a list of integers and `k` is an integer that need not be positive. Count the pairs of positions (i, j) with i < j such that |values[i] - values[j]| < k (strictly less). Equal values at different positions form a valid pair only when k > 0, since the difference 0 is then strictly less than k. Return 0 when k <= 0, for an empty list, for a list with fewer than two elements, or when no pair qualifies.
